scope: Existing PeptideMT #33 linked to a new distinct owning capability proposal after source and duplicate review; no implementation commission

owning_issue.title: Provide explicitly capped and stereochemically declared peptide reference templates
owning_issue.body:
## Consumer need

PeptideMT's target-directed demonstrator preparation (uibcdf/peptidemt#33, D52) needs chemically explicit peptide references before any later molecular-identity or affinity evaluation. One concrete source considered for a separate future panel reports acetylated/amidated p53 peptides: [Yadahalli et al., 2019, Methods](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-018-36589-5). That panel is not yet scientifically admitted. Unknown source termini/stereo must remain unknown; this proposal does not assign chemistry to them.

## Inspected existing operations

At `97a98578776291e6b2c048bcd876bdedc271967f`, source inspection only:

- [`physchem.get_peptide_chemical_template`](https://github.com/uibcdf/molsysmt/blob/97a98578776291e6b2c048bcd876bdedc271967f/molsysmt/physchem/get_peptide_chemical_template.py) already constructs coordinate-free references for explicit residue states and free amine/carboxyl termini. Its documented scope excludes capped/modified backbones and leaves residue and bond stereo unspecified.
- `build.build_peptide` and terminal-completion tools already own supported geometry construction; geometry is not a complete fixed chemical state.
- [`physchem.get_chemical_template`](https://github.com/uibcdf/molsysmt/blob/97a98578776291e6b2c048bcd876bdedc271967f/molsysmt/physchem/get_chemical_template.py) already receives one explicit CCD component and retains its source axes and interpretation. This does not by itself establish a supported composition for constructing the requested whole peptide from connected residue/cap references.
- `assess_chemical_template`, `apply_chemical_template`, `get_cip_stereochemistry` and exact declared-state atom correspondence already exist. Reuse them; none should infer the experimental chemical identity to satisfy its own prerequisites.

Please identify a documented public composition that already covers this need, or assess a bounded extension of the owner peptide-reference factory. This is a capability/profile proposal, not a reproduced defect or proof that every MolSysMT route lacks it.

## Proposed reusable outcome

Support caller-declared linear peptide reference chemistry with an explicit N-acetyl group and/or C-terminal primary carboxamide, keeping these distinct from free termini and N-methylamide. Preserve per-residue reference/stereochemical declarations under a named policy; do not equate every L residue with an S CIP label or silently choose unprovided configurations, including additional side-chain stereocentres. Unassigned/unsupported chemistry remains explicit.

Return coordinate-free reference chemistry, original group/atom correspondences, charge and stored/explicit-H policy, named fragment/link/cap definitions and source/version/attribution lineage. No automatic protonation prediction, normalization, conformer generation, coordinate repair, force-field assignment or consumer-side graph assembly is requested. General chemistry/link interpretation belongs here, not in PeptideMT.

Independent controls could use small nonbioactive model peptides: free versus acetylated/amidated ends; primary amide versus N-methylamide; declared enantiomers, glycine and residues with additional stereocentres; missing/contradictory declarations; explicit-H versus stored-H policies; source immutability and native history/persistence. Compose current assessment/application/CIP/correspondence tools and preserve their refusal semantics. The owner chooses API, scientific scope, data sources and implementation priority.

## Scope and scheduling

Related #557 owns CCD acquisition, completed #298 template application and #447 identity/overlap reporting. This proposal concerns construction of a declared peptide reference, not those operations or the cap-predicate semantics in #547. It creates no new 1.0 gate, release commitment or execution permission. It does not block PeptideMT's pending data-only reported-evidence curation, which admits no molecular chemical state. No provider code, model or molecular calculation is changed or run by this report.

consumer_handoff.body:
D52 reactivation/provider update — 2026-11-09.

The current review records DockingMT's published original reference receiving at dfff57a34f0278fa6185e88df2098ba6d650e90c, with its own exact case/composition/host limits. It is not PeptideMT receiving, an MDM2 docking/affinity result or local editable/public-package qualification. The bounded official workspace inspection preserves both clean primary sibling worktrees behind their fetched mains; no pull, build or installation follows.

Current MolSysMT source 97a98578776291e6b2c048bcd876bdedc271967f retains the inspected peptide-factory and application modules unchanged. Its public CCD factory and CIP analysis are also existing reusable routes. A separate concrete coverage need is now proposed in https://github.com/uibcdf/molsysmt/issues/685: caller-declared capped/stereochemical peptide reference construction, asking first for an existing supported composition or an owner-assessed extension. No local molecular builder, parser, cap editor or stereo kernel is added. This does not block source-scoped reported-data curation or request a new release gate.

The source supplement still returns a JavaScript proof-of-work HTML interstitial rather than the DOC; response identity/classification is retained and no challenge is solved. Source chemical unknowns remain unknown.

T1a's submitted proposal stays byte-identical (SHA-256 069247bf4b46e8fafba553ecb5311f67b0bfd6748ea4a06822053c3285c05e56) and pending scientific review. The objective reactivation is not recorded as a new model/chemistry/acceptance decision. The broader target-directed demonstrator remains incomplete. New work is source/evidence review and the owning proposal only: zero molecular/model calls and no runtime source changes.
